name: DS Cluster D13: Extended Hours
description: Tests: extended_market_data_source with pre/post market. Intraday only (5min bars).
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D13: Extended Hours
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
rth_close = src.c

# === EXTENDED HOURS: PRE + POST ===
ext = extended_market_data_source(include_pre_market=True, include_post_market=True)()
ext_close = ext.c

# === GAP ANALYSIS ===
gap = src.o - ext.c

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="RTH vs Extended Close",
    category="Extended",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="RTH", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Extended", color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(rth_close, ext_close))
